subject: 明代北方府城：山庄大院（原创扩展）；具体构件断代（待考）。
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is a precise footprint geometry template, image2 is the building/material edit target. Rebuild this Ming north Chinese wealthy merchant courtyard compound with exact geometry from image1. Keep image2 hall-and-two-side-wings arrangement, grey brick hard-gabled roofs, sober grey tiles, brown wooden lattice doors, entrance gate on front wall, and all realistic textures. Required ONLY change: lower the camera ground-edge pitch to EXACT 2:1 dimetric axes, 26.565 degrees to horizontal, slopes +0.500 and -0.500. Both diagonal families are parallel; no perspective convergence. KEEP footprint nearly-square 16 wide by13 deep: visible left-to-front stone base edge is 1.23077 times visible front-to-right stone base edge. Both dimensions nearly equal, do NOT elongate front facade. Build all walls and roofs aligned with exact input geometry template. Full thin stone rectangular pad visible at all three visible corners, foundation thickness only 2px, entrance steps stay inside footprint. Fine brickwork and tiles, hard gable walls flush with roofs, light upper-left, soft shadow only inside pad. Photoreal-painted strategy game 45degree isometric building sprite. Background true transparent alpha0, no background scenery or text, no people, no watermark. Final must be a faithful architectural rendition of image2 placed onto geometrically correct image1 footprint. Preserve transparent margins.

references.role: 精确几何参考；已view_image；仅供image_gen重建
建筑形制与材质参考；已view_image

visual_review: 第2轮逐张view_image两候选，选本轮整体较优图；主体、底角完整，RGBA透明，光源左上。实测斜率与宽深比见repair-r2记录，仍未同时达到审核几何阈值，保留candidate；未做仿射或透视纠偏。
source_point_semantics: 可见薄石基脚L/F/R外缘顶点；取alpha>200下轮廓辅助定位，屋檐、台阶不作占地角
selection_reason: 两候选内优先保留形制与材料，并兼顾斜率和比例；未达标如实登记
negative: 排除项完整内嵌于prompt；工具无独立negative参数。
final_view_image_review: 第2轮已逐张view_image规范化成品：轮廓及底面完整，透明留边，左上光向、纹理密度可读；几何仍有已登记残差，尚不通过严格审核。
